Welcome back, Screamers!

Over the months, we have continued updating Screamer also following your feedback. We have a new patch available and, considering the important updates included, such as the Single Stick mode, we asked Federico Cardini, Screamer’s Game Director, to show you what’s new.

Hello Screamers! This patch adds a brand-new way to control your cars in any game mode called Single Stick mode: activating it allows you to Steer and Drift using a single stick on the controller. Note that Twin Stick is still the recommended way to enjoy the game at its fullest since the ECHO System has been designed around that, but we understand that the unique Twin Stick controls might feel weird on their first few uses, so we decided to add this new option for players who prefer to start with something more familiar.

notes.title: Here are the complete patch notes

items.text: New Control Mode - Single Stick
You can now select a new control mode that combines Steer and Drift on a single stick. This can be changed to/from the default Twin Stick from the options menu outside of races.
General
The gameplay camera you select in a race will now be set as your default camera for the following races.
Added a new unlock condition for the Tournament Crew characters: you can now unlock them in any game mode after having unlocked all other characters and tracks.
The Tournament
Reviewed all dialogues to remove unnecessary suspension lines.

Thank you again for your support; your input is always a source of improvement. See you on the racetrack!

Hello Screamers!
This patch brings with it some important bug fixes and buffs to the characters that are currently under performing in races.

In particular, check out the new Aisha ability! Before, you only had 1 free shield during a race but now the ability recharges, making Aisha much harder to take down. Combined with her innate high speed, this should make her a new contender to the top position in Races and Team Races.
We're also making a change on how the game starts: if you've never played it before, it will now bring you to the Main Menu instead of going straight into the Tournament story mode.

This is because we understand that not everyone might want to play the story and also in-game tutorials are now available from the options menu, so we no longer feel the need to make sure you see the essential ones in the first events of the story mode.
We're also continuing to take action against illegitimate leaderboard times obtained through cheats or other unfair methods.
Following internal investigations, a number of times have been removed, and a warning has been sent to offenders. Players who continue to engage in unfair behavior may face further sanctions.
On first boot of the game you'll now be brought to the Main Menu instead of starting The Tournament. This change as also been applied to the Demo Version of the game.
During races you can now see your set customization for each car.
Ability now recharges after 45 seconds, granting her multiple free shields throughout a race
Reduced the threshold to activate SGU from 282.5km/h to 268 km/h .
Increased passive sync generation rate
Increased active shift generation rate
Increased maximum entropy by one
Fixed an issue where Akane could activate Strike and the Boost gained from her Skill at the same time
Fixed an issue on some peripherals where force feedback wasn't working properly and couldn't be tweaked from the options menu.
Fixed an exploit that allowed players to gain very high scores using the Pause button.

Hello Screamers! This additional patch contains a long awaited fix on unlocks not working correctly.
Unlocks

Fixed an issue where various unlocks (tracks, characters, gallery items) where not being unlocked upon reaching the required conditions. This fix builds on the similar one done in the previous patch, so players that still had items locked from playing in previous versions should now finally see them as available.

Hello Screamers! This patch brings new features meant to improve the online experience, and adjustments to The Tournament difficulty.
New Feature - Online Connection Quality Indicator
Added a new indicator to all Online game modes that shows the quality of the connection to the server.
New Feature - Online Join as Spectator

When searching for a new race online it is now possible to join lobbies that have a race already in progress. When this happens the player joins the race as a spectator, to become an active player as soon as the next race starts. Lobbies already in progress that are not full are always prioritized by matchmaking over new lobbies.
Unlocks

Fixed an issue where various unlocks were not properly awarded when achieving the required conditions. Players that have already reached the conditions will have the unlocks available as soon as they start the game.
The Tournament
Event 38: reduced the aggressivity of the AI at all difficulty levels. This makes the Event easier overall.
Event 66: reduced the frequency of AI using Overdrive during the event, making it easy to catch up to it.
Fixed an incorrect subtitle for an Akane line in the first cutscene of Strike Force Romanda.
Fixed an issue where, when Traditional Chinese was selected, subtitles where shown in Simplified Chinese instead.
Fixed an issue where in the US and UK languages some cutscenes showed the \\n characters at the end of some subtitles.
Fixed subtitles being desynced in the Event 66 cutscene.
Cars
Fixed an issue with the customization of Hope's car were the right mirror of the Color 02 set was not changing color correctly.
AI
Fixed an issue where Neural brake/throttle was slowing down the vehicle when nearing the limits of the track during a turn.
Fixed an issue where AI performance was decreased between races when performing a specific set of actions.
Time Attack
Fixed an issue where exiting the game mode as soon as the Time Attack was over could trigger an unresponsive game state.
Online
Relaxed the ping restrictions to join an online race.
Decreased lobby timer before a race to 1 minute.
Tracks
Fixed various locations on the Hawk Trail and Tireburner tracks were colliding with track limits at high speed could cause the car to explode.
Fixed the invisible collision at the entrance of the shortcut in the Steel Bowels track.
Fixed an issue on all tracks of the final environment were invisible collisions could disrupt the cars behaviors.
General

Fixed the Hope's Mastery achievement/trophy not tracking progress correctly. Unfortunately, in order to fix this bug we had to reset the achievement in game's progress. If the achievement/trophy was already in progress tracking will resume updating once the previous value is reached again.
Numerous other bug fixes and improvements.

Hello Screamers! With this patch we're adding a highly requested feature and set up for future updates by fixing bugs that affected stability and gameplay.
New Feature - Pause Menu Tutorials

When playing in any Arcade game mode, all gameplay mechanics Tutorials can be accessed with a new dedicated button in the Pause Menu. The very first time you enter any Arcade game mode this menu will be opened automatically.
The Tournament
Fixed various Róisín text dialogues saying 'fuck' instead of the Irish slang 'feck'. This is done to make those lines correctly reflect the spoken dialogue.
Fixed minor inconsistencies between various spoken and written dialogues.
Cars
Noboru: raised collision shape of the car to avoid unexpected collisions with the track in certain circumstances.
Fermi: raised collision shape of the car to avoid unexpected collisions with the track in certain circumstances.
AI
Fixed AIs performing a Perfect Boost every time they used a Boost. This fix affects all difficulty levels and all game modes.
Fixed various performance bugs with the AI Assist option , which caused its performance to be lower than intended.
Online
In order to improve the online experience, we're doing changes to how matchmaking operates. Searching for a lobby might take longer, but the resulting race should offer a more stable experience.
Increased lobby timer before a race to 2 minute. This allows for more people to join a lobby before the match starts.
Fixed the issue where, during Matchmaking, the game wasn't progressing to the Lobby screen after a match was found.
Fixed a bug where performing certain actions with Mr. A and then exploding would cause him respawn on the track slower than intended.
Fixed various bug that could cause unintended behaviors when joining a Lobby while in a Party.
Fixed players distances not being present in the leaderboard during races.
Checkpoints
Fixed Checkpoint Drones having collisions on all Tracks.
Tracks
Fixed invisible collisions in the Steel Bowels track that, in extreme cases, could impact cars handling.
Fixed the rain sound being played in the Misty Hills track.
PC Only
Fixed the game not starting correctly when Serbian is set as the system language.
General
Fixed the Boost HUD sound not stopping if the Boost HUD disappeared immediately after being triggered.
Changed the description of the Hunter achievement/trophy to make the objective clearer.
Fixed some cutscenes using UK English subtitles instead of US Subtitles when setting US English as the chosen language in the Options.
Numerous other bug fixes and improvements.
